{{Quote|Check this out&mdash;arc welder, hydrospanner, fusioncutter, spot sprayer, foam sealant, torque wrench, and power calibrator. My Tread's a mobile multitool.|[[Cubber Daine]], on his WED Treadwell repair droid|<ref name="TNEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Power calibrators''' were common tools in use throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were used to evaluate the performance of electronic devices, and allow a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] to diagnose and repair issues with the equipment.

==Description==
Power calibrators were common tools<ref name="TEGWT" /> used to evaulate the performance of equipment such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. The tool collected data on a device's energy output and efficiency. The [[Technician/Legends|technician]] using the power calibrator could detect if a device was losing energy or malfunctioning; the problem could then be located by using the tool's circuit tester, power flow detector,<ref name="TNEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> connector rods, and internal control [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Repairs could then effected using the tool, making it a useful tool for users maintaining droids, vehicles, and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] computers.<ref name="TEGWT" /> It was a common technician's tool, found in most [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kits]].<ref name="SECR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Power calibrators could also be used as emergency power sources, plugging into smaller devices such as [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], and [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] and providing them with power to run for several [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]]. Some power calibrators, such as [[Udrane Galactic Electronics]]' [[ReliaCharger power calibrator|ReliaCharger]], were capable of power larger devices such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]] or even [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] for a much shorter duration.<ref name="TNEGWT" />

==History==
Power calibrators were used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="BtR">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>

Some [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED Treadwell repair droids]] were equipped with power calibrators which they had built into the ends of some of their many [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. A [[Unidentified Imperial Security Bureau WED Treadwell repair droid|WED unit]] that the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] used on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was equipped with a power calibrator when it attempted to place a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacon]] on the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working for the tech salvaging company [[IsoTech]].<ref name="BtR" />
